title: The Signature International Student Services Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Official advising resources, orientation, and immigration-service contacts. The International Student Services Database records official advising offices, orientation programs, and published immigration-service contacts for international students, plus links to official government guidance. Records note which services require appointments and what documents to bring. The Signature side adds arrival checklists covering the first two weeks in a new country.
capabilities: Record international advising offices with contacts and hours
Document orientation programs and required sessions
Link to official government immigration guidance
Provide arrival checklists for the first two weeks
Note appointment requirements and documents to bring
